query.User: Hey, can you assist me in some travel planning?
query.Assistant: Of course, I'd be happy to help. Where are you planning to go, and is there any particular event you interested in?

query.User: I'm interested in going to some concerts.
query.Assistant: Sure, in which city do you plan to attend a concert?

query.User: Los Angeles. And also, is there a way for you to search any flights for me?

function.name: FindEvents
function.description: Find cultural events - concerts and plays - happening in a city. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

function.name: BuyEventTickets
function.description: Buy tickets for a cultural event and date in a given city. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

function.name: SearchOnewayFlight
function.description: Search for one-way flights to the destination of choice. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

function.name: SearchRoundtripFlights
function.description: Search for round-trip flights to the destination of choice. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.
